name: Pace
oneSentence: Pace estimates how many possessions a team plays, a measure of how fast the game flows.
whyItMatters: Faster pace inflates raw counting stats; efficiency metrics help compare across speeds.
howToInterpret: Higher pace = more possessions = more counting-stat opportunities.
howDrblUses: Explained here for context. Game Lab doesn't estimate possession counts for single games.
caveats: Not available as a first-class GameSummary field for season evidence.
